capabilities: Add YouTube tracks as notes with title, channel, and thumbnail
Download and cache audio locally with yt-dlp and ffmpeg
Play local audio files from the vault
Manage playlists as companion notes embedding Bases files
Show a turntable now-playing card with queue, repeat, and autoplay
disambiguation: Not an audio recorder or text-to-speech tool; it plays music playlists whose tracks are Markdown notes.
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.13.0+). yt-dlp and ffmpeg must be on PATH for downloading; without them, only local vault audio plays. The README includes detailed network, file-access, and clipboard disclosures.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to play music playlists whose tracks and queue live in notes and Bases files.

relations.evidence: The plugin runs yt-dlp as a child process to download audio, resolve stream links and expand playlist links.
ffmpeg, which yt-dlp uses to convert audio to MP3 or WAV
Adding a track sends its video URL to youtube.com/oembed, through Obsidian's requestUrl

summary: Music player that stores tracks and playlists as Markdown notes, playing YouTube, cached, and local vault audio in a sidebar player.
